profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | React.js, Typescript, Java
profile.summary:
With over 8 years of experience as a full stack software engineer, I have developed and delivered scalable, performant, and user-friendly web applications using React, TypeScript, Java, and other technologies. I have worked in various environments, from startups to large corporations, and in small to medium-sized teams, adapting to the needs and processes of each organization.

My most recent role was senior software engineer at Figure, a fintech company that leverages blockchain, AI, and analytics to create innovative financial solutions. There, I created the front end in React to manage organization metadata, which enabled the company to speed up the onboarding process of new partner organizations. I also collaborated with designers, backend engineers, product managers, and other teams to refine the UI/UX, develop RESTful API contracts, and coordinate the release of new features. As a software engineer at USAA that was tech lead on a project where I designed and implemented a full stack solution using React, Java, Kafka, and Apache Druid to detect model drift on our models. I am passionate about finding new ways to improve the product and the user experience, and I am always eager to learn new skills and technologies.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Created customer facing FE in React using Typescript to manage Users and Organization Metadata working closely with designers to refine UI/UX, backend engineers to develop RESTful API contract, product manager on timelines/requirements, and other teams to gain an understanding of their requirements and coordinating release of new features. This effort helped to speed up the time to onboard new external Organizations to use Figures’ Private Label systems, freed developer resources that were previously needed in the onboarding process, and enabled partner Organizations to manage their users and Organization Metadata.
- Autonomously completed large projects in React for the front end and Kotlin for the back end as part of the Customer Service Portal (CSP) team. Drove requirement gathering, coordinated with other teams/testers, and developed solutions to reduce friction points in the code for developers and in the UI/UX for users.
- Helped transition CSP and Private Label repositories from Redux to React-query and converted code from Javascript to Typescript.
- Used data from Full Story to make data driven requirements to improve Lead Portal Application UI/UX first time experience.
- Utilized Rollbar to diagnose bugs in production and was then able to provide a quick turnaround for fixes while communicating with the stakeholders the bug and the timeline for a fix.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · Git · Kotlin · TypeScript · Web Development · React.js · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · REST APIs

positions.title: Software Engineer I (Senior)
positions.description:
- Tech lead on project to detect model drift on models. Designed and implemented a full stack solution using Apache Druid, React, Java, and Kafka with the team.
- Learned React for model drift detection project and taught the team how to develop in React.
- Setup and led regular meetings with the project’s customers to allow for a quick feedback loop.

positions.title: Software Engineer II (Mid)
positions.description:
Technology/Language/Frameworks/Tools: Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, Apache Kafka, SQL, Git
- Worked with multiple teams on multiple projects simultaneously developing new features.
- Researched and presented findings of possible solutions to be used on a model drift detection project to the team.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Technology/Language/Frameworks/Tools: Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, SQL, SVN, HTML, CSS, SASS, Javascript, jQuery
- Gathered requirements, designed, and developed full stack solutions through the software development cycle with a team on multiple major features using mockups, client-facing consulting, and meetings with SMEs.
- Developed a time tracking/project management system for team as sole developer.
- Developed new functionality on Java based backend while benchmarking memory and CPU usage to support a focus on performance optimizations.
- Followed an agile software development workflow using Scrum and Jira.
positions.insights: Skills: CSS · Spring Framework · jQuery · REST APIs · JavaScript · HTML · Java

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
- Full-stack Java web development (Spring, MyBatis, Java Server Faces, RichFaces, HTML/CSS/JavaScript, jQuery, Google Maps API) using Eclipse, Tomcat, Subversion, Ant, and MS SQL Server).
- Designed and implemented new functionality into production software based on requirements.
- Iteratively designed web pages to continuously improve the UI and UX.
- Created time estimates for assigned tasks from the backlog following the agile methodology.
- Developed SQL tables and queries to be used by the backend Java logic
- Supported Chrome, Firefox, IE8, IE9, IE10, and IE11 compatibility
positions.insights: Skills: CSS · Spring Framework · SQL · jQuery · REST APIs · HTML · Java

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Full-stack Java Web development using GWT, Java, HTML/CSS, Eclipse (IDE), JSP, and Mercurial (version control system)
- Collaborated with a team to create requirements and plan/design new systems
- Presented code regularly to the team to iterate design and implementation 
- Developed website interface/functionality using GWT to be used in multiple environments, including Firefox, IE8, IE9, IE10, and IE11
- Worked with local and remote teams and created time estimates for assigned tasks from the backlog following the agile methodology.
- New functionality was written using Java and would encompass creating new elements, communicating with the back-end, and adding the behavior for the web page.
- Google Web Tools (GWT) takes code written in Java and compiles it into browser specific JavaScript to create new elements and functionality into the front end of the application
- Java was used in the JSP in order communicate with the back-end when it was not possible through GWT

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
- Researched solutions to current needs of the team, then performed deployment, administration, and maintenance of server services.
- Setup multiple CentOS servers for testing new builds and an instance for customer preview of company software.

positions.title: Lab Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Created, developed, and teach labs based on physical and simulated sensor networks.

positions.description: Created, developed, and teach labs based on physical and simulated sensor networks.

positions.title: Student Research Assistant
positions.description: Research in Sensor Networks with Dr. Soliman and a team of undergrad/grad students. Duties included setting up equipment for experiments and developing code for the motes.

positions.title: Camp Counselor
positions.description: Responsibilities included monitoring campers blood sugar level several times a day during entire stay, administering/monitor morning insulin campers take, and running camp events.
